description: This Java class LogWrapper implements the LogNode interface and provides a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging messages with various priorities and supports chaining multiple LogNode objects for complex logging workflows.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to enable chained logging output.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable. It forwards the message to the Android Log and passes it along the chain if applicable.
